summary: Implemented SCH-04 escalation timers across HUMAN_TASK activation, scheduler firing, and task completion cancellation while keeping transition.zig pure.
implementation_notes: Added a distinct human_task_escalation timer contract and persistence path in scheduler/store.zig, including task-scoped cancellation on completion.
Added transaction-scoped task reassignment in tasks/store.zig so scheduler firing can append ESCALATION and reassign in the same transaction.
Updated instance task-activation paths to create escalation timers atomically for initial task creation, applyTransition(), and completeTask()-spawned tasks.
Updated completeTask() to cancel pending escalation timers atomically in the same transaction as task completion.
Updated the scheduler poller to branch on timer_type, append ESCALATION only while the task remains PENDING, skip locked task rows, and preserve first-commit-wins race behavior.
Added focused SCH-04 integration coverage for activation-time timer creation, escalation firing plus reassignment, and completion-time cancellation.
security_review: All new SQL remains parameterized. No secrets were added. transition.zig was not modified, preserving the zero-I/O rule.
